description: [Nouveaux flux Wifi territorial] Durée des sessions utilisateurs is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Opendata de Grand Paris Sud. Analyse de la durée des sessions des utilisateurs du Wifi Territorial. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Télecommunications. The portal shows 120,244 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-08-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
